index.intro: This works out your exact age today from your date of birth, in years, months and days, and how long it is until your next birthday.
index.faq: Leap birthdays and other awkward dates

past.intro: Exam results, a wedding photo, a form asking your age "at the date of the incident": give both dates and see how old you were then, down to the day.

label.on: The date to look back to

difference.intro: Put in two dates of birth to see who’s older and by how much, in years, months and days.

days-between-dates.intro: From today to a deadline, or across a whole year: see how many days there are, how many are weekdays and how many fall at the weekend.
days-between-dates.howto: Start day in, end day out

chronological-age.intro: 8;4;12 is how score sheets want it, and that’s what you get here: a child’s age on the test date, ready to copy or print for the file.

dog-age.intro: Big dogs age faster than small ones, so times seven gets it wrong. Pick your dog’s adult size and the human years come straight off the AAHA-published chart.

cat-age.intro: Your cat’s age in human years, and the life stage vets use for it. There’s no size to pick for a cat, so all it needs is years and months.
cat-age.faq: Senior cats and the times-seven rule

korean-age.intro: Korean age counts you as 1 at birth and adds a year every 1 January, so it can run two ahead of your international age. Here you get both, with year age in between.

birthday-countdown.intro: For cards, parties and plain impatience: the days left until the next birthday, and the day of the week it lands on.

how-old-will-i-be.intro: Pick a future year and give your date of birth to see the age you’ll turn that year, and the exact day it happens.

what-year-was-i-born.intro: An age on its own fits two birth years, depending on whether the birthday has passed this year. Say which and you’ll get one year; if you’re not sure, you’ll get both.
what-year-was-i-born.howto: From an age to a year
what-year-was-i-born.faq: Why you sometimes get two years
